sentences.text: FDA first posted the morphine sulfate injection shortage on 2017-10-31 and it remains current as of 2026-10-21.
The shortage listing names Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC, Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc., Hospira, Inc., Amphastar Pharmaceuticals, Inc., and Piramal Critical Care Inc. as affected companies.
FDA's OAI classification letter to Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC is dated 2017-12-28, 58 days after the initial shortage posting.
Fresenius Kabi's plant (FEI 3001833549) received an OAI classification after an inspection that ended 2011-07-08, with the classification known on 2017-12-28.
Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. (FEI 2220525) has had multiple VAI inspections, most recently ending 2024-06-12 with classification known 2024-12-16.
Hospira, Inc. (labeler for NDC 00409189001) appears on the shortage list with a current status since 2017-10-31.
The recommended action is to transfer 51 units of 2 mg/mL, 1 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East, which would raise Corvale East from 2.7 to 5 days on hand while Corvale General retains 14 days.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
